tool.name: TN93 Filter
tool.description: - remove sequences from a reference that are within a given distance of a cluster
tool.command: cat '$reads' > filtered_msa.fa && tn93 -o pairwise.csv -s filtered_msa.fa -t $threshold '$clusters' && python '$__tool_directory__/tn93_filter.py' --reference '$reference' --distances pairwise.csv --reads filtered_msa.fa --clusters '$clusters'
tool.help:
TN93 Filter -----------
Compute pairwise distances between the aligned reads and a set of compressed clusters using the [Tamura Nei 93 distance](http://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/8336541), then add to the reads every cluster sequence that is not within the distance threshold of any read, along with the reference sequence.
NOTES -----
All sequences must be aligned and have the same length. Only IUPAC characters are recognized (e.g. no ~).
